import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem dyadic_prefix_product (r : ℕ) :
  (∏ k ∈ Finset.range r,
      ((2 : ℕ) ^ (2 ^ k) + (3 : ℕ) ^ (2 ^ k))) =
    (3 : ℕ) ^ (2 ^ r) - (2 : ℕ) ^ (2 ^ r) := by
  induction r with
  | zero =>
      norm_num
  | succ r ih =>
      rw [Finset.prod_range_succ, ih]
  
      have hle : (2 : ℕ) ^ (2 ^ r) ≤ (3 : ℕ) ^ (2 ^ r) := by
        gcongr <;> norm_num
  
      have hle' : (2 : ℕ) ^ (2 ^ (r + 1)) ≤ (3 : ℕ) ^ (2 ^ (r + 1)) := by
        gcongr <;> norm_num
  
      have hfactor :
          ((3 : ℕ) ^ (2 ^ r) - (2 : ℕ) ^ (2 ^ r)) *
              ((2 : ℕ) ^ (2 ^ r) + (3 : ℕ) ^ (2 ^ r)) =
            (3 : ℕ) ^ (2 ^ (r + 1)) - (2 : ℕ) ^ (2 ^ (r + 1)) := by
        apply Nat.cast_injective (R := ℤ)
        rw [Nat.cast_mul, Nat.cast_sub hle, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_sub hle']
        push_cast
  
        have hexp : 2 ^ (r + 1) = 2 ^ r + 2 ^ r := by
          simp [pow_succ]
          ring
  
        rw [hexp, pow_add, pow_add]
        ring
  
      exact hfactor
